'''Filemon Uriarte Jr.''' (born October 15, 1945) is a Filipino [[chemical engineer]]<ref name=":0">{{Cite book |last=Publications |first=Europa |url=https://www.google.com/books/edition/The_Environment_Encyclopedia_and_Directo/q_FROqap0F8C?hl=en&gbpv=1&dq=Filemon+Uriarte+Jr.+October+15,+1945&pg=PA547&printsec=frontcover |title=The Environment Encyclopedia and Directory 2001 |date=2001 |publisher=Psychology Press |isbn=978-1-85743-089-9 |language=en}}</ref> who served as Secretary of the [[Department of Science and Technology (Philippines)|Department of Science and Technology]] of the [[Philippines]] under [[Joseph Estrada]].<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |last=Parnala |first=Adam |date=2022-08-21 |title=LIST: All the DOST Secretaries in the Philippines |url=https://www.noypigeeks.com/government/dost-secretaries/ |access-date=2026-02-24 |website=NoypiGeeks |language=en-US}}</ref>

==Education==
Uriarte completed a B.S. at the [[University of the Philippines Diliman]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=University of the Philippines Industrial Engineering Alumni Association |url=https://upieaa.org/ie-alumni-take-center-stage-at-the-2015-upae-homecoming/ |access-date=2026-02-26 |website=upieaa.org}}</ref> in 1965 and a Ph.D. at [[Carnegie Mellon University]] in 1970.<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":2">{{Cite web |title=NAST Members |url=https://members.nast.ph/index.php/list-of-nast-members/details/1/79#educational-background |access-date=2026-02-24 |website=members.nast.ph}}</ref>

==Career==
He served as [[Secretary of Science and Technology (Philippines)|Secretary of the Department of Science and Technology]] starting on February 1, 1999<ref name=":1" /> until his resignation in November 2000.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Villanueva |first=Marichu A. |title=Science department head tenders resignation |url=https://www.philstar.com/headlines/2000/11/29/88953/science-department-head-tenders-resignation |access-date=2026-02-24 |website=Philstar.com}}</ref>

He is an Academician of the National Academy of Science and Technology.<ref name=":2" />
